title: Anti-Slop Cannon Vetting
rules: Immediately disqualify candidates or deal proposals that output generic, middle-of-the-road LLM boilerplate without deep domain nuance.
Reject zero-context first drafts: force minimum one round of iterative critique focusing on what to cut, what to keep, and where the blind spots are.
Calibrate AI simulations against cold reality: ingest meeting transcripts and financial actuals to update working models rather than relying on hypothetical outputs.
